primary.excluded: All other trials, in particular 79 and 90–95. These held trips already appeared in a movement study. Next-unit identity is a different endpoint.

external.transfer_only: The first ten source trial rows (0–9), in source order, irrespective of their lengths, activity or scores. An independently sorted rat from the same collection. Never align unit IDs between animals. If source or license verification fails, report coverage missing.

clock: 1 ms non-overlapping absolute source-time bins (left, right], indexed by ceil(time_seconds * 1000) - 1. Include an event exactly at the issue time in the known history, so all eligible targets have strictly later event times on the source clock. Retain complete bins with left edge at or after trial start and right edge at or before trial stop. Produce a forecast at the RIGHT edge of every occupied eligible bin including bins with multiple events, using every observed spike count through that bin. The endpoint is the identity in the very next occupied bin in this trial. Score only if that target bin contains exactly one spike. Multiple spikes in the target bin are unresolved at this analysis resolution, including multiple spikes on one unit. Censor the last forecast at trial end. No target time, gap length, future activity, camera, motion, identity label or absolute date enters the scorer. No prediction from a partial leading bin or before the first observed eligible bin.
candidates: All source unit rows, in original order, known from the sorting table before replay. Never remove an inactive unit. Source-unit detection uptime and online sorter latency unknown. Reject malformed packets (invalid IDs, bounds, counts, nonfinite or unordered within-unit times); report failure, never stitch across a known unavailable interval. A clean event list does not prove continuous unit availability.
state: Reset at every trial. Accumulate the count per unit; at occupied bin j update each exponential trace by multiplying exp(-elapsed_bin_s/tau) then adding the new unit counts. Variables are under a shared rule at every unit. No recording-level calibration, target-fitted weights, hidden-state carry through skipped trials, or held-derived prior. Adaptation starts on the first observed bin.
model: Shared conditional softmax across local candidates. Five features per unit: log(1+cumulative_count), log(1+trace_10ms), log(1+trace_100ms), log(1+trace_1000ms), and 1 if that unit fired in the last completed occupied bin. Fit single coefficient vector, no intercept, no unit ID or animal embeddings, on all resolved training transitions, minimizing mean event natural-log loss + 0.0001/2 * squared L2 norm. Deterministic float64 L-BFGS-B, initial all zeros, maxiter 100, ftol 1e-10, gtol 1e-7. No tuning. No precision or method choices selected from evaluation.

comparators.training_marginal: Same-recording candidate counts from all complete training bins plus one pseudo-spike per candidate. Inapplicable on ER1; no fictitious cross-animal row matching.

metrics: Publish identical-row top-1 tie-fractional correctness, mean midrank (1=best), natural-log loss, unit-balanced mean top-1 and log loss over units with scored target, equal-trial macro means, per-trial results, first 1–10, 11–100 and later occupied source bins, missingness/censoring and candidate coverage. Separate each recording. Paired equal-trial mean differences in log loss versus available controls with 5000 trial-bootstrap percentile intervals, seed 20261121, interpreted descriptively because trials are consecutive in one recording per animal. Separately time single-event CPU update+model scoring on a fixed fictional stream, report median and p95, hardware and unmeasured live delay.
freeze: Protocol fixed before opening identity targets or scoring either evaluation. Freeze fitted weights and code hash before either held evaluation. Report every planned result irrespective of direction; no post-hoc selection of animal or trials.
